entities.summary: Mark Nikolayevich Yevtyukhin was a Russian Lieutenant-Colonel and Commander of the Pskov-based 2nd Battalion, 104th Guards Airborne Regiment, 76th Guards Airborne Division, who was killed in action during the Battle for Height 776.0 near Ulus-Kert, Chechnya. For his actions in that battle, he was posthumously honoured as a Hero of the Russian Federation.
